text:
In my flower I have hidden

so that, if you carried me on your breast,

without suspecting it, I too would be there...

And only the angels will know the rest.


In my flower I have hidden

so that, when I slip from your vase,

you, without knowing it, may feel

almost the loneliness I have left you.

translation.title: In My Flower I Have Hidden...
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the flower as secret presence and later absence.
